blocks.text:
After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your flight to Uyuni.

Sightseeing begins on arrival.

The first stop is the Train Cemetery, where old locomotives once used to transport minerals are still standing.

Next you’ll travel to Colchani, where you can see how salt is dried, ground and packaged. Souvenirs and items made from salt are also sold here.

You’ll then see the salt mounds, the so-called ‘water eyes’ where groundwater reaches the surface, and a former salt hotel that now houses a salt museum.

Lunch is served in the middle of the salt flat.

After lunch, you’ll head to Incahuasi Island, home to giant cacti, some of which are more than 100 years old.

Next you’ll visit Coquesa, where mummies dating to around AD 700 still have patches of skin, hair and nails intact.

You’ll then climb to a viewpoint on Tunupa Volcano. You may spot flamingos in the area.

Return to Uyuni and transfer to your hotel.

Dinner is included.

**Transport:** Toyota Land Cruiser 4x4.  
**Maximum capacity:** 4 passengers, plus a driver and guide.
A distant off-road vehicle on Bolivia’s flooded Uyuni Salt Flat, with clouds reflected in the water
Sky and clouds reflected in the water on the Uyuni Salt Flat

After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your flight to La Paz.

You’ll be met on arrival and transferred to your hotel.

The rest of the day is free.
